summary: AMTD Digital filed a 6-K disclosing a November 2, 2026 transfer of four premium hotel assets to its controlled subsidiary The Generation Essentials Group under an October 21, 2026 Asset Transfer and Share Issuance Agreement. Aggregate purchase price was US$209,766,000, including underlying debt, satisfied by issuance of 198,630,381 new TGE Class A shares priced off the 30-day VWAP for the period ending May 29, 2026. Post-deal AMTD Digital holds 88.2% of TGE (91.1% voting power), AMTD IDEA 95.6% beneficially. Watch related-party valuation and minority overhang.
